sense: the page for one plan diagram
definition: The page for one plan diagram: its rooms, outside walls and connections, how it grows, what it trades away, and the styles it is native to.
basis: The page is the workbench's own; what it shows is the parti record. schema/parti.schema.json: "Dimensions come from the room catalogue and are scaled to the brief" and "Every parti gives something up, and a composer that cannot say what will pick badly." and "A style not listed can still use it; the composer will say so."

surface.what: One plan diagram: its rooms, which walls face outside and what connects to what, how it grows, what it gives up, and the styles it is native to.
read: A parti states topology and roles only; room sizes come from the room catalogue, scaled to the brief.
What it trades away is stated as plainly as what it is good at.
A style not listed may still borrow it, and the composer says so when it does.
ask: Which styles is this plan diagram native to?
What does this diagram trade away?
How does this diagram grow when the brief gets bigger?
